o.text: Borrowed from Persian اثر (asar), from Arabic أَثَر (ʔaṯar).

From gey + -im.
Cognates
Cognate with Bashkir кейем (kiyim), Kumyk гийим (giyim), Kazakh киім (kiyim),Kyrgyz, Southern Altai and кийим (kiyim), Tatar кием (kiyem), Crimean Tatar and Uzbek kiyim (“clothing”), Turkish giyim, Turkmen geýim etc.
